question.text: A custodian for a Cat III AIF scheme must be appointed:

answer.text: Prior to the date of first investment of the scheme

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular Jan 12, 2024, Custodian must be appointed prior to the date of first investment of the scheme. The Trap: Post-First-Close/Final-Close appointment violates the requirement. Cross-Exam Context: Recent amendment worth memorizing. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Sequence: register → appoint Custodian → first investment.
